field: exact device locale
completed_independent_work: The app visibly rendered English copy in the pinned runtime; alternate locales are outside the approved dossier scope.
fallback: Treat the observed English app UI as the runtime language authority without asserting a device locale.
resume_procedure: The device owner opens Settings → General → Language & Region on the physical iPhone.
The owner reports only the Language and Region values, or approves a tightly cropped screenshot containing only those values.
The discovery driver updates the authority and environment cell without retaining Apple ID, location, preferred-language history, or other settings.

field: Nihongo account/purchase entitlement state
affected_records: future Search rows whose behavior differs by entitlement
completed_independent_work: No in-app account, sign-in state, trial banner, paywall, or entitlement badge was visible on the empty Search root. The installed app identity and build are pinned.
fallback: Describe only the observed installed runtime and do not call it paid, Pro, trial, subscribed, or account-bound.
resume_procedure: The device owner states whether this installation is paid/Pro, trial, free, or otherwise entitled without disclosing an Apple ID or receipt.
During Search reconnaissance, record any limit, paywall, restore-purchase control, or entitlement-dependent Search behavior if it becomes reachable.
Update the authority and every affected journey row with the confirmed state and evidence source.
blocks_final_rows: Any later row claiming paid/Pro-only Search behavior

field: camera, Photos, Files, and clipboard permission/access states
affected_records: future image and input journey rows
completed_independent_work: Files single and multiple selection were observed with isolated synthetic fixtures. The private-access Photo picker opened and was cancelled without selection or retained evidence. The stakeholder then waived Camera and Photo Library source mechanics for this discovery outcome.
fallback: Keep future clipboard-input permission claims unknown; Camera and Photos rows are excluded under the recorded stakeholder scope decision.
resume_procedure: For any future clipboard-input claim, replace the Mac clipboard with a known synthetic value before focusing Search.
Record whether iOS prompts, allows, denies, or transfers that exact synthetic value.
Restore the starting clipboard state if it can be done without reading or retaining private content.

field: device-local Copy Text payload from an Image Text result
owner: discovery driver with a device-local paste target or semantic clipboard authority
completed_independent_work: Copy Text was selected on a purpose-created result and visibly dismissed its menu. Reading the Mac clipboard returned a pre-existing Mac value, so Universal Clipboard cannot be used as evidence of Nihongo's copied payload.
fallback: Use visible recognition overlays and token selection as parsing evidence; do not claim the exact Copy Text serialization.
resume_procedure: Open IMG-FIXTURE-001 through Files and select Copy Text.
Paste into an isolated, empty, device-local text destination without invoking the Mac Universal Clipboard.
Capture and compare exact text, order, whitespace, punctuation, omitted non-Japanese content, and multi-image behavior, then delete the synthetic paste.
blocks_final_rows: Exact Image Text Copy Text serialization

field: content-size category
completed_independent_work: The exact screen geometry and 3× display scale are pinned in the baseline evidence.
fallback: Describe geometry as observed without labelling the content-size category.
resume_procedure: The device owner reports the current Settings → Display & Brightness → Text Size position and whether Accessibility Larger Text is enabled.
Record the resulting category only if iOS or an approved inspection tool exposes its canonical name; otherwise retain the observed geometry without inference.
blocks_final_rows: Any later row claiming Dynamic Type behavior

field: Nihongo accessibility hierarchy
completed_independent_work: iPhone Mirroring and Xcode Accessibility Inspector were both attempted against the pinned runtime; only the mirroring shell tree was returned.
fallback: Use a device-owner-assisted VoiceOver traversal and keep screenshots classified as visual rather than semantic evidence.
resume_procedure: Retry Accessibility Inspector with Nihongo foregrounded and iPhone Mirroring disconnected.
If elements remain unavailable, traverse each approved Search surface with VoiceOver and record labels, traits, focus order, actions, and transitions using synthetic content.
Keep each accessibility row blocked until that environment-bound evidence exists.

field: individual removal of a session-created recent-search row
completed_independent_work: A known session-created もんだい row was rerun without inspecting older history. Clear All was ruled out because it would delete pre-existing data.
fallback: Retain the exact row-removal action as untested; do not infer swipe affordance or persistence.
resume_procedure: Create or identify the current top session-created Search row without opening any older row.
At action time, obtain confirmation to permanently remove that one disposable row.
Swipe only that row, record the exposed control and settled result without retaining older history, and verify the query no longer reruns from that row.

field: standard iOS software-keyboard appearance and dismissal
affected_records: future keyboard visual and accessibility rows
completed_independent_work: Focus, Cancel, clear, hardware-key input, handwriting, radical, and input-mode accessory behavior were captured. Selecting keyboard mode hid the custom panel but did not expose a software keyboard in the mirrored runtime.
fallback: Treat typed-input behavior as observed but keep software-keyboard geometry, keys, input source, and dismissal unknown.
resume_procedure: Disconnect any external keyboard path from iPhone Mirroring or use the physical iPhone with the software keyboard forced visible.
With only a synthetic query visible, capture appearance, input-source switching, dismissal, Return/Search, and focus restoration.
Use a privacy crop if recent history is visible above the keyboard.
blocks_final_rows: Future standard software-keyboard visual and interaction rows

field: long Search-result list scrolling and terminal extent
owner: device owner or discovery driver with a working physical swipe authority
completed_independent_work: Long result classes were captured at the top, and visible rows were inventoried. The available scroll command did not move the mirrored list; a coordinate attempt activated an Additional Match and proved its Word Detail edge instead.
fallback: Do not claim terminal-row, pagination, lazy-load, or scroll-restoration behavior.
resume_procedure: Open the synthetic もんだい or think result set on the physical iPhone.
Swipe the results list to its terminal extent without selecting a row, capturing each newly revealed layout or control.
Return from one newly revealed result, record scroll-position restoration, and repeat until no new rows or controls appear.

field: Search offline, failure, and retry states
completed_independent_work: A deterministic no-match state and all required online fixture classes were captured. No distinct loading state persisted long enough to capture.
fallback: Keep offline, transport failure, stale data, and retry behavior unknown; do not equate the blank no-match state with a network error.
resume_procedure: Confirm a network-isolation method that will not strand iPhone Mirroring, or perform the probe directly on the physical iPhone.
Record the connected starting state, run one cached-looking and one uncached synthetic query, isolate network access, and repeat them.
Capture immediate and settled states, any error copy or retry control, restoration after reconnect, and whether earlier results persist.
Restore the recorded network state before ending the session.

field: audible word and sentence pronunciation behavior
owner: device owner with a synchronized audio-capable recorder
completed_independent_work: Visible word and sentence speaker controls were exercised. No persistent visible playback state was established, so audible content, voice, timing, overlap, interruption, completion, and replay remain unknown.
fallback: Keep audio claims blocked; a static speaker icon is not evidence of sound content or playback behavior.
resume_procedure: Attach an authorized local audio recorder that captures iPhone Mirroring or physical-device output without uploading content.
Use public fixtures いる, 問題, and 蝶々 and record the settled state before each action.
Capture word and sentence playback start, duration, completion, repeated taps, overlap, interruption by navigation/backgrounding, and recovery.
Hash the trace and retain only privacy-safe derived observations in the dossier.

field: entries with absent, unavailable, or disabled word/sentence audio
completed_independent_work: Available-looking controls were observed across common, uncommon, verb, noun, and adjective fixtures.
fallback: Do not claim that audio is universally available or infer disabled-state appearance.
resume_procedure: Search deliberately rare public entries and example sets until an absent or disabled word and sentence audio class is found or a documented denominator proves none exists.
Capture the full settled state and attempt the control where present.
Record separate unavailable-word and unavailable-sentence classes.

field: note editor software-keyboard appearance and dismissal
completed_independent_work: Empty and populated focus states, external-key input, Done, Back auto-save, persistence, deletion, and restoration were captured.
fallback: Keep keyboard geometry, input-source controls, Return behavior, and dismissal unknown.
resume_procedure: Force the software keyboard visible on the physical iPhone without exposing private history.
Open Add Note on a public fixture and capture empty, typing, multiline, dismissal, refocus, and Done states.
Delete the synthetic note and verify restoration.
blocks_final_rows: Note software-keyboard visual and interaction rows

field: interactive swipe-back and long-press behavior
owner: device owner or discovery driver with working physical-touch capture
completed_independent_work: Back controls, scrolling, taps, and nested navigation cycles were captured. A controller drag did not produce a verified swipe-back transition, and no duration-controlled long press was available.
fallback: Do not infer gesture behavior from standard iOS conventions.
resume_procedure: Use the physical iPhone with a synchronized screen recording and public fixtures only.
Test edge-swipe back from Example Sentences, nested Word Detail, and Conjugations, including canceling mid-gesture.
Long-press linked tokens, related rows, meaning text, and speaker controls; record any menu or no-op disposition.

field: word/detail, examples, conjugations, notes, and audio offline/failure/retry behavior
completed_independent_work: All retained fixtures were observed in the normal connected state. No distinct loading, error, retry, or stale state was claimed.
fallback: Do not equate locally available dictionary content with proven offline behavior.
resume_procedure: Confirm a network-isolation method that will not strand iPhone Mirroring, or perform the probe directly on the physical iPhone.
Open cached-looking and previously unopened public word/example fixtures, isolate network access, and repeat navigation, conjugation, note, and audio actions.
Capture immediate and settled states, errors, retries, stale content, and recovery after reconnect.
Restore the recorded network state.
blocks_final_rows: Word/detail offline, failure, retry, and recovery

field: exhaustive reading, element, contribution, related-word, origin-collapse, and missing-data fixture closure
owner: discovery driver on the pinned physical iPhone
completed_independent_work: Four public fixture runs covered complete and missing metadata, simple/medium/complex stroke sequences, multiple and historical elements, origin expansion, element alternatives, linked-kanji cycles, related-word lists, and etymology help.
fallback: Do not infer untraversed rows from visually similar rows or claim that missing meaning, reading, origin, or stroke-order classes do not exist.
resume_procedure: Reopen the exact fixtures 静, 争, 一, and 鬱 from the empty Search root and use kanji-crawl.json as the tested baseline.
Exercise each reading row, meaning/sound element row, alternative glyph, contribution row, related-word row, and history collapse separately, recording its settled destination and Back restoration.
Search rare public kanji until absent meaning, reading, origin, and stroke-order classes are each found or a documented denominator proves a class unavailable.
Add every new node and action with stable IDs, privacy-safe evidence, and a terminal disposition.

field: Kanji-family long press and interactive swipe-back behavior
owner: device owner or discovery driver with synchronized physical-touch capture
completed_independent_work: Back controls, scrolling, taps, inline expansion, overlay controls, nested navigation cycles, and cold relaunch were captured.
fallback: Do not infer gesture behavior from standard iOS conventions.
resume_procedure: Use the physical iPhone with a synchronized privacy-safe screen recording and public fixtures only.
Long-press the glyph, readings, element rows, origin text, word rows, and stroke controls.
Test edge-swipe back and mid-gesture cancellation from Kanji Detail, Kanji Element Detail, Kanji Etymology, and the stroke overlay.

field: Kanji detail, element, origin, etymology, word-link, and stroke-order offline/failure/retry behavior
completed_independent_work: All retained fixtures were observed in the normal connected state; a deterministic cold relaunch was captured separately.
fallback: Do not equate visibly local dictionary or animation content with proven offline behavior.
resume_procedure: Confirm a network-isolation method that will not strand iPhone Mirroring, or perform the probe directly on the physical iPhone.
Record one previously opened and one new public kanji fixture, isolate network access, and repeat detail, element, etymology, word-link, and stroke actions.
Capture immediate/settled error, stale, retry, and recovery states, then restore the recorded network state.
blocks_final_rows: Kanji-family offline, failure, retry, and recovery

field: authoritative stroke-animation duration, per-stroke timing, and interruption timing
owner: discovery driver with synchronized local screen recording
completed_independent_work: One-, eight-, and 29-stroke animations were visibly run; pause/resume, stepping, completion, close, platform interruption, and cold relaunch were observed.
fallback: Retain qualitative animation behavior only; do not publish numeric timing from tool-call wall time.
resume_procedure: Record the one-, eight-, and 29-stroke overlays locally at a known frame rate.
Measure open, per-stroke, inter-stroke, pause, resume, completion, and close intervals from frames.
Repeat interruption by navigation and backgrounding, hash the trace, and retain privacy-safe derived measurements.

field: retained settled terminal screenshot for the 29-stroke 鬱 animation
completed_independent_work: The settled terminal frame was visually observed with counter 29, all strokes white, and the play control restored; initial and paused-at-13 evidence is retained.
fallback: Keep the observation as an uncaptured runtime fact and do not treat it as screenshot-backed evidence.
resume_procedure: Search depression, open 憂鬱, select 鬱, and open its stroke overlay.
Play to completion without other clipboard or navigation actions, verify two stable reads, and copy the settled frame before relaunch.
Hash and add the frame to kanji-evidence-manifest.json.

field: controlled pitch-data matching across homographs, readings, parts of speech, and proper nouns
owner: discovery driver on the pinned physical iPhone
completed_independent_work: Visible pitch contours were captured for public fixtures including 問題 and いる, and research verified CJKI as the named licensed provider while preserving the exact delivery and matching layer as unknown.
fallback: Treat each captured contour as presentation evidence only; do not infer CJKI record identity, part-of-speech matching, proper-noun logic, transformations, or fallback.
resume_procedure: Reconnect iPhone Mirroring or use the physical iPhone directly and restore Nihongo to empty Search.
Run purpose-created controlled fixture groups that hold reading constant while varying writing, homograph sense, part of speech, and proper-noun status.
Capture each result and Word Detail contour, absent/duplicate states, ordering, and linked state/action IDs.
Compare only observable fields; keep exact CJKI product, version, record IDs, and internal transformations unknown until separately authorized evidence identifies them.

field: recorded-pronunciation versus speech-synthesis selection and fallback
owner: device owner with discovery driver and synchronized audio-capable recorder
completed_independent_work: Word and sentence speaker controls were visibly exercised across common and uncommon public fixtures. Research established historical human-recording and speech-synthesis features but not current clip identity, voice configuration, routing, or fallback.
fallback: Do not label any observed speaker control as recorded audio or text-to-speech and do not claim voice, rate, cache, network, or fallback behavior.
resume_procedure: Attach an authorized local recorder that captures device audio and screen without uploading content.
Choose public entries known or suspected to have a human recording plus deliberately rare entries and examples likely to require fallback.
Record control state, audible output, voice consistency, timing, repeated taps, interruption, backgrounding, cache behavior, and offline behavior.
Crosswalk a clip to a named public source only when stable metadata or an authorized hash proves identity; otherwise retain source as unknown.

field: formal repeated-run variation for ranking, handwriting, radical, example, and OCR behavior
owner: discovery driver on the pinned physical iPhone
completed_independent_work: The 35 source fixture cases and their single formal executions were cross-indexed. A new taberu baseline was attempted from empty Search, but iPhone Mirroring paused before a settled product result and remained at Connecting to iPhone 17 Pro Max after Resume and a second stable read; no failed-run product claim or screenshot was retained.
fallback: Treat all current output and ordering observations as one-run facts and publish no variability rate, deterministic-order claim, or boundary generalization.
resume_procedure: Make the physical iPhone available, unlock it if required, and reconnect iPhone Mirroring; verify two stable reads of empty Nihongo Search before acting.
Repeat think, tabeta, handwriting 丁, radical 薮, example selection, and all five image fixtures at least three times from recorded restored starting states.
Add one-property handwriting contrasts for partial, reversed-order, extra-stroke, kana, and non-jōyō input, plus zero-result and large-set radical contrasts.
Record output/order deltas, run count, screenshots or synchronized traces, network state, and exact restoration between runs.
